::: {#or-prisma-check}

This is the PRISMA 2020 checklist for the completed review (Page et al. 2021).
A retrospective PRISMA-P protocol is deposited at Zenodo [@MikovaProtocol2026];
it was prepared after the search (29 April 2026) and was not registered in
PROSPERO.

<!-- Položka 5: bez DOI se nevyřazuje. Položky 16–17, 24, 27 jdou z live stats / Zenodo cite keys. -->

| Section / topic | # | Checklist item | Location in this review |
|:---|:--:|:---|:---|
| Title | 1 | Identify the report as a systematic review | Title |
| Abstract | 2 | See the PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts checklist | Abstract (draft until the body is final) |
| Rationale | 3 | Describe the rationale | Importance of Soil Moisture; Existing reviews and Research Gap; @or-reviews |
| Objectives | 4 | Provide an explicit statement of objectives | Aim and Scope of this Review |
| Eligibility criteria | 5 | Specify inclusion and exclusion criteria | Data Selection; Data Workflow. Inclusion: SM estimation/monitoring/mapping; remote sensing (satellite or UAV); agricultural setting; 2019–2026; English; primary research (journal article, conference paper, or book chapter kept at audit). Exclusion at audit: books (`TY` BOOK/EBOOK) and duplicates by DOI or title–year. Records without a DOI are retained. Reviews set aside (`is_review`). Automated exclude: relevance score &lt; 3 |
| Information sources | 6 | Specify databases and date of last search | Web of Science (Clarivate) and Scopus (Elsevier); last search **29 April 2026**. No trial registers, grey literature, or citation chasing |
| Search strategy | 7 | Present full search strategies | Five concept groups; full Boolean strings in @or-search |
| Selection process | 8 | How studies were selected; how many reviewers | Rule-based relevance score (0–8) on title, abstract, and keywords, then a **manual check of scores**. One-person machine-assisted screen, **not** independent dual screening. Disagreements: not applicable (no second screener) |
| Data collection | 9 | How data were extracted; how many extractors | Semi-automated templates (`extraction_templ.py` prepares sheets; it does not flag must-cite). Full-text extraction of the must-cite subset by one author. A second extractor and a conflict rule are not reported |
| Data items | 10 | List extracted variables | Platform, sensor, domain, method, scaling, UAV relevance (automated); study-level inputs, applications, methods, UAV campaign parameters (manual). Per-study fields: @or-inputs, @or-applications, @or-methods, @or-uav |

| Effect measures | 12 | Effect measures for each outcome | No meta-analysis (N/A) |
| Synthesis methods | 13 | Methods to synthesise results | Descriptive counts and categorical aggregation. Heterogeneity of designs, sensors, and metrics is the reason for no pooling |
